requirement: Soft delete one metric rule: load the live rule by id, stamp IsDeleted/DeletedAt without touching its metric, criterion, or sibling rules, and report an unknown or already-deleted id as not found.

preconditions.text: A live metric rule exists for the target id
The rule is a scoring rule or a major/minor rule
Two sibling rules of the same metric exist
The target id matches no live rule

inputs.text: Delete a scoring rule of the CURB-65 metric
Delete a major/minor rule of the IDSA/ATS metric
Delete the middle one of three rules on the same metric
Delete request with an unknown id
Second delete request for an already deleted rule
Delete request for a rule that was soft deleted beforehand

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; the rule keeps its payload and gains a deletion timestamp
The metric and criterion of the rule stay live
Sibling rules of the same metric stay untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Metric rule does not exist' error
A rejected delete never moves an existing deletion timestamp

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing or already-deleted rule is returned as a failed Result
